_meta.description: The four treatment routes, ordered by the EU waste hierarchy. Reuse and recycling count as circular.
_meta.source: Directive 2008/98/EC (Waste Framework Directive), Article 4 waste hierarchy; recycling definition Article 3(17) includes reprocessing of organic material (composting, anaerobic digestion) but not energy recovery.

rows.name: Reuse
rows.description: The item keeps its form and goes back into use, e.g. pallets or metal offcuts resold.

rows.name: Recycling
rows.description: The material is reprocessed into new material: paper mill, steelworks, film regranulate, panel board, anaerobic digestion.

rows.name: Recovery
rows.description: The material is burned for energy (energy from waste, biomass, refuse-derived fuel). The material itself is lost.

rows.name: Landfill
rows.description: Deposit in a non-hazardous landfill. Lowest in the hierarchy and taxed.
